state:
Goal `core-time-instant-and-1-more` covers every `Core\Time\Instant` and `Core\Time\TimeOfDay` member, not
only the three the last handoff named. On disk for `Instant`: `compareTo`, `minus`, `in`, `toEpochSeconds`,
`toEpochMillis` and `toEpochMicros` have about.md, three examples with `.out`, one attack, one bench, a Rust
`#[test]` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs`'s tests and a `covers:`-marked `.nvst` case. `plus`, `since` and
`toIso` already carry a `covers:` marker on an existing `.nvst` case and owe the rest. The three epoch
readers' cards no longer promise a `RuntimeError`: every instant fits a 64-bit microsecond count, and
`instant_epoch_readings_truncate_toward_zero_and_reach_both_ends` pins both ends. Every `Core\Time` bench is
re-measured with `bun nv proofs --record-perf` after the last `time.rs` edit, because any edit makes them
all stale. No proof found a bug. Nothing is blocked.
